sloka: अथाददे सूर्यमरीचिकल्पं स ब्रह्मदण्डान्तककालकल्पम्।अरिष्टमैन्द्रं निशितं सुपुङ्खं रामः शरं मारुततुल्यवेगम् ।। ६.६७.१५४ ।।
transliteration: athādade sūryamarīcikalpaṁ sa brahmadaṇḍāntakakālakalpam।ariṣṭamaindraṁ niśitaṁ supuṅkhaṁ rāmaḥ śaraṁ mārutatulyavegam ।। 6.67.154 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Kumbhakarna's words Rama was bewildered. He discharged plumed arrows at a speed of thunderbolt. Struck by the arrows the enemy of Devatas was not shaken or agonized.
